note: The entry names the edition, not a column: both columns of 'Födelseland' take its period, and the sibling variant's parseable edition keeps its own.
fails_if: `compile_errata` places an `[[errata.edition_period]]` on only the first matching record of the named edition, or on records of another variant, so C keeps no period or B moves to 2018

sources.description: Variant 2 delivers A (variable 5, CVID 20) and C (variable 6, CVID 22) in the topic-named edition 'Födelseland', which names no period; variant 3 delivers B (variable 7, CVID 21) in edition '2021'.
